text.text: The control room behind your client pages. Everything for every client lives here; each client page shows only that client's work.
This page shows your projects, what we need from you, invoices and requests. Message us any time.
Thirty days after the issue date unless the invoice says otherwise.
Open the deliverable and tell us in the feedback box. We mark it Approved on our side.
Add the client in the Clients table.
Duplicate a client home page and change the filter to that client.
Share only the client home page with them.
Add projects, deliverables and invoices as they happen.
Keep this page private. Clients should never see other clients' work.
Client row created with a main contact
Home page shared with the client
How fast do you reply to requests?
In the deliverables on your home page.
Yes, send us their name and email.
Not seeing your question? Send a request from the Requests list on your home page. We answer within one working day and add anything common to this page.
What happens when I approve a deliverable?
The deliverable is marked Approved and we move on to the next one. You can still ask for small changes for a week after.
How do I pay an invoice?
Open Invoices on your home page. Each invoice lists the amount, the due day and how to pay.
The project manager listed on each project. Their name and email are on the project row.
